changes: AArch64 raw copies use exact 64-byte paired SIMD blocks and original scalar tails, without Rust references to racing guest bytes or added fences
Joined newfstatat prepares the actual query and observes proc demand; independent results are reused within that call, proc-dependent queries are repeated after publication
Apple native metadata uses relative fstatat with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW_ANY instead of opening/stating/closing the parent; unsupported older kernels and Linux retain their capability walks
Joined positioned writes reuse the existing bounded service transfer buffer; no per-process buffer, new thread or extra I/O lock
method: Same maintained C fixture and ELF as the previous native interop record; assertions and byte/size/checksum validation enabled
Cached 8 MiB set, 2 GiB read64k / 1 GiB write64k / 100000 read4k or path-stat operations; startup, initial population and final fsync outside interval
Three shuffled repetitions of before/private, before/shared, after/private, after/shared, after/shared with watch or flock, and three native Mac variants (108 completed observations)
Same Linux ELF was run natively on the existing 6-vCPU/8-GiB ARM64 VZ/ext4 Linux CI VM; unchanged native reference reused from hostfs-interop.json
VM stopped and compilers/samplers idle during the final Mac performance sweep; sampling and intermediate raw-copy measurements are separate runs
Profiles are 10 ms wall-stack samples, not exact CPU-time accounting; idle Hypervisor clock threads are included in raw leaves and must not be counted as active work
Profiles use fixed 2-second windows; post-change stat uses a longer work count to keep the process alive. Missing leaves are below the reporting threshold, not proof of zero calls
These complete-path cached measurements include different kernels, libc, pathname layouts and runtimes; they do not establish SSD throughput, cold I/O or native parity

final_performance.scope: single process, cached 8 MiB file, fixed work; no rendering/network

native_linux_reference.virtualization: Lima VZ ARM64 native Linux kernel

checks.targeted_proc_stat_regression: new process behind proc symlink refreshes; ordinary queries avoid refresh; failed lookup preserves output
checks.raw_copy_boundaries: unaligned source/destination, 64-byte block boundaries and scalar tails preserve bytes and neighbors
checks.scope: Reused unchanged CPU/network/graphics acceptance; runtime unit/integration suites and affected kernel paths rerun locally

remaining_costs: Native file read/write syscalls and HVF execution/exit boundaries remain
Guest copying and per-page validation/materialization/physical-slot lifecycle remain; no direct guest-buffer disk DMA contract was introduced
Shared path stat still repeats component metadata checks; this change introduces no cross-syscall namespace or permission cache
MAP_SHARED and native POSIX range locks retain their previously documented unsupported scope
